text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — I'm putting together a modular SI onboarding + certification pipeline for partners who will integrate Redwood Dedicated and Marketplace SKUs. Goal: a 6-week enablement track + a lightweight cert exam. Rough outline below, need volunteers for curriculum, labs, and the cert rubric.

Maria Lopez: Love this. Can we make modules self-service? Recorded labs + hands-on HW kit would scale best.

Samir Patel: +1. Proposed modules: infra setup (VPC/KMS), model ops (pinning/rollouts), performance tuning (batching/quant), GTM (marketplace listing + joint announcement).

Kim Nguyen: Also need an SI sandbox with sample workloads + an automated test harness for the cert. I can own the test harness.

Ecosystem Ops Bot: Meeting created: "SI Enablement Sprint kickoff" — Thu 10:00 AM PT. <https://cal.link/si-enable-kickoff>

Alex Chen: Thanks @Kim — can you sketch acceptance criteria for the cert? Thinking minimal perf targets, deployment checklist, and a short recorded customer demo.

Kim Nguyen: Draft cert acceptance criteria: 
- Deploy Redwood Private integration in sandbox
- Perf smoke: p95 inference < 200ms for 512 tokens on dedicated profile
- Inference test suite: pass rate >= 95%
- Submit a recorded 10-min customer demo showing end-to-end flow
I'll post the checklist to product-playbooks and link here.

Maria Lopez: Timeline?

Samir Patel: Proposed sprint plan:
Week 0: create curriculum + lab content + HW kit spec
Week 1-2: pilot with 2-3 SI partners (hands-on)
Week 3: cert exam beta + feedback loop
Week 4: GA + marketplace listing + joint announcement prep

Alex Chen: Volunteers so far: @Maria to lead curriculum, @Samir to run pilots, @Kim to build test harness + certify criteria. I'll own the marketplace listing template and joint announcement checklist.

Maria Lopez: Sounds good — I'll draft learning objectives for each module and start recording short walkthroughs. Need docs help for install scripts (cc @eng-docs).

Samir Patel: I'll contact HW partners about loaner GPU kits and shipping logistics. Also will prepare an onboarding checklist for integrators with a sample infra diagram.

Kim Nguyen: I'll drop a proto cert checklist and the test harness repo link in this thread by EOD Monday.

Alex Chen: Action items (quick):
- Maria: draft modules + learning objectives by Fri
- Kim: cert acceptance + test harness prototype by Mon
- Samir: vendor HW shortlist + logistics POC by Mon
- Alex: announcement + marketplace template by Fri
Please post short status updates here as you make progress. :rocket:

Maria Lopez: Noted and added to calendar.

Samir Patel: 👍

Kim Nguyen: Will do — will ping when repo is up.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — excited to get this rolled out. If you have partner suggestions for the pilot, drop them here or DM me.
